source: VitalDB official FHIR API; original recordings, not PulseDB
labels: Median systolic peaks and median intervening diastolic troughs from simultaneous ART; no ART-derived input features
selection: Fixed-seed shuffled case IDs; first eligible unique patients with all three tracks and sufficient quality windows. No selection on prediction errors.
split: Patient-disjoint, assigned before training, uncalibrated test; no test-subject BP supplied to inference
scope: Pilot engineering gate, not clinical certification or astronaut/flight-hardware validation. No live-service activation on failure.
